Job Description
Role Summary
We are seeking a high-impact Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the strategy, evolution, and technical stability of our Customer Experience (CX) ecosystem. Having completed a migration from Salesforce to Zendesk Enterprise, we are now building a proactive, automated, high-efficiency CRM.
In this role, you will serve as the "Enterprise Systems & AI Product Owner." You will lead a team of two Zendesk Specialists, collaborate directly with enterprise clients to scope API integrations, and drive cross-functional engineering projects. You will be responsible for turning Zendesk into an AI-enabled workspace-deploying Zendesk Copilot, AI Agents for deflection, Zendesk AutoQA, Zendesk WFM, Glean Enterprise Search, and Gemini LLM integrations.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic AI Ecosystem & Native Zendesk Optimization
Autonomous AI Deflection: Build, optimize, and oversee Zendesk AI Agents (Bots) to increase self-service resolution rates for Tier-1 inquiries.
Agent Copilot & Productivity: Architect and fine-tune Zendesk Copilot (Auto-Assist workflows, real-time ticket summarization, and suggested next actions) to reduce Average Handle Time (AHT) and cognitive load.
100% Automated Quality Governance: Established Zendesk AutoQA scorecards and automated grading logic to continuously evaluate 100% of human and bot interactions, using sentiment analysis to flag churn risks and coaching opportunities.
Workforce Management (WFM): Oversee Zendesk WFM (Tymeshift) configuration to transition from reactive staffing to data-driven, predictive capacity planning.
Platform Architecture & Tool Integrations (Glean / Gemini)
Enterprise AI & Search Readiness: Partner with engineering and data teams to connect enterprise search tools (Glean) directly into Zendesk so agents can search across Confluence, Drive, and internal tools from a single workspace.
Gemini LLM Workflows: Build data pipelines and API hooks to connect Gemini/LLMs for predictive retention modeling, automated drafts, and custom object field enrichment.
Internal Tool Middleware: Oversee integrations between Zendesk, internal ERPs, product databases, and middleware (eg, Webhooks) to create a single 360-degree CRM workspace.
Customer API Discovery & Developer Experience
External Client Solutions: Interface directly with strategic business clients and account executives to gather technical requirements for direct API access, custom webhooks, and dedicated customer portal integrations.
Developer Experience: Partner with internal software engineers to maintain clean, secure, rate-managed, and well-documented Zendesk REST APIs for customer usage.
Governance, Stability & Knowledge Architecture
Environment Governance: Establish strict Sandbox-to-Production release pipelines, manage API rate limits, audit trigger loops, and ensure compliance (GDPR/Data Privacy).
Knowledge Architecture (KCS): Lead a Knowledge-Centered Service strategy to consolidate company-wide documentation into a structured source of truth indexed within Zendesk.
Team Leadership: Directly manage and mentor 2 Zendesk Specialists, managing sprint planning, task prioritization, and platform issue triage. Qualifications
5+ years in Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, or CX Platform Ownership.
Zendesk Enterprise Mastery: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex Zendesk instances, including Sandbox environments, Custom Objects, Omnichannel Routing, Copilot, AI Agents (Bots), AutoQA, and WFM.
Integration & API Technical Depth: Proven experience with REST APIs, Webhooks, JSON, OAuth, Postman, and middleware integration tools (Workato, Zapier, n8n).
AI & Search Engines: Hands-on experience or technical project delivery involving Enterprise Search (eg, Glean, Coveo) and LLMs (eg, Google Gemini, OpenAI).
Client Engagement: Ability to run discovery meetings directly with tech teams to translate business needs into clear technical specifications.
Preferred Qualifications:
Zendesk Certified Systems Architect.
Demonstrated track record implementing Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles across multi-department teams.

Job Title: AI Platform Engineer
Location: Pan India ( remote)
Timings :11 am to 8pm

Job Summary
This is a hands-on build role on a new team. PairSoft is standing up a central AI services platform that will be consumed by every product line in the portfolio. You will build the platform, not maintain a legacy stack. You will make daily technical decisions that shape how AI is delivered across the company, and you will see your work in production, in front of real customers, on a short cycle.
You will work alongside two or three other senior engineers on the founding platform team. In the first three to six months you will focus on shipping the v1 platform: model gateway, RAG-as-a-service, evals and observability, guardrails, and cost tagging. You will help migrate existing product AI features onto the platform and harden the operational surface.

Location: Remote (anywhere from India)

Responsibilities / Essential Functions
Build
Design, build, and operate services in the central AI platform. Every service should have clear API contracts, versioning, and SLOs from day one.
Write production Python for AI services. Contribute to shared libraries, SDKs, and integration patterns that product teams will consume.
Instrument everything: cost tagging per request, latency and error metrics, quality signals, and audit logs. If it is not measured, it is not shipped.
Own on-call rotation for the AI platform services you build. Author runbooks and improve them after every incident.
Partner
Work directly with product engineering leads across the product lines to onboard their AI features onto the central platform.
Provide technical support, integration guidance, and troubleshooting to product teams consuming platform services.
Contribute to Architecture Decision Records. Push back on decisions you disagree with; document tradeoffs.
Operate
Set the operational bar: observability, alerting, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
Own vendor evaluation for tools in your area of specialization. Run bakeoffs when the choice is not obvious. Make cost, quality, and reliability tradeoffs explicit.
Contribute to the AI security posture: PII handling, tenant isolation, prompt injection defense, and audit logging within your services.
Applied AI & RAG Engineering
The AI-forward end of the platform. You build the retrieval, prompt, and guardrail systems that make LLM output good enough to ship to customers.
RAG-as-a-service platform: ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval quality, and hybrid search.
Prompt engineering at scale: templates, evaluation, versioning, and per-tenant customization.
Guardrails and content safety: input filtering, output validation, PII redaction, tool-use sandboxing.
Agent frameworks and tool-use patterns as agent workflows move into production across product lines.
Domain-specific fine-tuning experiments and quality benchmarking.
Backend & Platform Engineering
The foundation of the AI platform. You own the model gateway, orchestration layer, service mesh, and the data plumbing that ties everything together.
Multi-provider model gateway with routing, fallback, retry, and rate-limit logic.
Prompt registry, versioning, and rollout controls (canary, feature flags).
Shared libraries and SDKs for product-team consumption. API contracts, versioning, deprecation strategy.
Tenant isolation architecture: how customer data flows through platform services safely.
Cost attribution and budget enforcement at the gateway layer.
MLOps/ LLMOps Engineering

Your contributions will have a significant impact on our products success, and you will be part of a team that is passionate about innovation, creativity, and excellence. Above all else, you will have the freedom to drive innovation and take ownership of your work while honing your problem-solving, collaboration, and automation skills. Together, we can make a difference in the world of cloud-based managed services.
Who You Are
You re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you re open and borderless naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
Required Technical and Professional Experience
1-3 years of experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects
Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills
Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git & GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark.
Agentic AI Systems is a plus: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Knowledge Systems is a plus: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions.
Cloud & Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures.
Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, Rest based web services
Deep understanding of OOP and Design patterns
Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl

From your very first day, you ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won t just contribute you ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here and we re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact Join us and help shape what s next.
